name: osis
description: OSIS 桥梁设计分析软件的 AI 插件：同时连接并控制本机多个 OSIS 实例，按真实 Python API 建模、改模型、跑计算，内置常用桥型模板与建模技能，全程在本机运行。AI plugin for OSIS bridge design & analysis software: connect to and control multiple local OSIS instances, build and edit models and run analyses with the real Python API, with built-in bridge templates and modeling skills. Runs entirely on your machine.

interface.shortDescription: 用 AI 操作 OSIS 桥梁设计分析软件 | Drive OSIS bridge design & analysis software with AI
interface.longDescription: 连接本机的 OSIS 桥梁设计分析软件：选择模型、查询 OSIS Python API、在模型中执行 Python，完成建模、修改与计算，数据不出本机。Connects to OSIS bridge design & analysis software on your PC: pick a model, look up the OSIS Python API and run Python in the model to build, edit and analyze bridges. Everything stays on your machine. OSIS 官网 / Official site: https://www.osisbim.com/osis/home/
